source.name: WWE corporate press release - Riyadh to host WWE Crown Jewel on Saturday, November 7
source.note: Announcement 'from the General Entertainment Authority, on behalf of HE Turki Alalshikh, in partnership with WWE'; Crown Jewel on 7 Nov 2026 at Riyadh Season Stadium at KAFD, part of Riyadh Season's sports and entertainment calendar; notes Riyadh Season will host WrestleMania 43 in 2027.

note: 2026 season host-fee/branding deal for Crown Jewel: Riyadh; the event's venue is named Riyadh Season Stadium at KAFD (WWE event page https://www.wwe.com/event/crown-jewel-0, opened). Value not published.
